source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: Virtual events and competitions are not sanctioned by the NDCA, and no virtual event may be attached to a sanctioned event.

requirement: A declared remote or virtual component is not offered for an NDCA-declared event; the rule is about events, not a rule on where an individual judge sits.
enforcement_point: Planned (docs/competition/governance/judging-integrity/OD-05-conflicts-design.md section 6E): judging-arrangement declaration and _compoc_blockers_judging_arrangement for the declared body. Not built.
interpretation_notes: Event-level rule; whether it also bars a remote judge at an in-person event is not stated. NOT IMPLEMENTED (design only, PR-A section 6E): a BLOCKER to activating an NDCA profile; no test; no compliance claimed.
decision_refs: OD-29 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option A, body-specific judging-device and location attestation, design only; retrospective audit PR #795)
